title: Design: Modern invoice prints no Scope of work heading without a tech story
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Legacy invoice layout is off (Settings, then Invoice), so work order 1's invoice prints in the modern layout.
  • Make sure Require Tech Story is off (Settings, then the Work Orders tab), so line 1 can be completed without a tech story.
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with two labor lines: line 1 titled "Replace tie rod" with the description "excessive play", and line 2 titled "Align front axle" with the description "pulls left".
  • Have line 1 completed with no tech story and line 2 completed with the tech story "Aligned to spec", and work order 1 completed and invoiced today as invoice A.
  • Start on work order 1.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Finance tab.
  2. Set the Estimate / Invoice toggle to Invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1's Finance tab opens.

Step 2:

  • Invoice A shows in the modern layout.
  • Line 1 prints "Replace tie rod" in bold, then "excessive play", and nothing under it: no "SCOPE OF WORK" heading.
  • Line 2 prints "Align front axle" in bold, then "pulls left", then the small grey heading "SCOPE OF WORK" and "Aligned to spec": the heading shows only for the line that has a tech story.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 16 (27 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks)

  • Key Decisions: “The narrative carries no label either, and "Scope of work" was considered and rejected. The two invoice views disagree about the label and agree about everything else. The legacy view prints the narrative as a plain paragraph under the description with no label. The modern view prints it under a "Scope of work" heading. Both print the title and the description unlabeled, both put the narrative last, and both drop it entirely when it is absent. Printing no label is the only choice that matches what a customer sees in either view. Rejected: "Scope of work", which only half our customers see, and "Tech Story", which is the one label a customer has objected to in writing (SV-6582).”
  • Feature Overview, Out of scope: “The customer-facing estimate, invoice and credit documents. They have never printed either question and are untouched.”

From: Product's answers to our questions 9-14 (Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, Google Doc 1QcT7FRZci6AhYcI33HUac-Oob03-gCnCOKn2NFHMLjA, saved in po-answers-2026-10-27/), read 28 Oct 2026

  • Answer 14: “14. Yes, the "Scope of work" heading is left out with the tech story, so nothing prints under the description. The invoice itself isn't part of this change. Separately: a tech story of only spaces prints the heading over a blank block. That's an existing invoice bug, so please log it as its own ticket and keep it out of the What/Why test cases.”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
